# Error codes of the model document (beta)

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/gen_error_codes.py from axionmultiphysics._core.error_codes(); do not edit by hand. -->

Most findings about a model document (a design with a `physics` section) carry a `code`: a stable identifier of the form `area.problem`, for programs and assistants to act on, beside the message, the JSON pointer and the hint that people read. This page lists every code of the model path. A few findings carry no code, and for them the message, the pointer and the hint are all there is: the ones that an electromagnetic design can also have (a required field that is missing, a field that does not exist, a value of the wrong type or out of its range), an expression that cannot be read or evaluated, an unknown value of `symmetry`, of a study `type`, of a coupling `strategy` or of a continuation `scale`, and an internal failure of the validation. Model documents are **beta**: this version validates a model document (`axmp validate`, `Design.validate()`), resolves its geometry (`axmp resolve`), explains it (`axmp explain`), patches it (`axmp patch`), lists and checks its named boundaries (`axmp boundaries`) and meshes a planar or axisymmetric one (`axmp mesh`, `axmp.mesh`); it solves none (no route is implemented), so a code may still be renamed. Some codes are raised for electromagnetic designs too: `model.section_needs_physics` (a section of a model document in a design without `physics`), the refusals of an `arc` path (`geometry.arc_span`, `geometry.arc_degenerate`, `geometry.arc_negative_r`) and `mesh.tangled`, when a 2D mesh with a tangled curved element is read.

A finding has one of four kinds:

| kind | meaning |
|---|---|
| error | The document is wrong, and is refused. |
| unavailable | The document is valid; this version or this build cannot solve it. |
| deferred | A check that needs the resolved geometry or an imported mesh file, and runs when that is built or read. |
| warning | The document is valid; something about it is worth knowing. |

This version raises 107 codes and names 3 more that a later version raises. The types, coupling terms and routes that the codes refer to are in the [physics catalogue](physics_catalogue.md).

## Boundaries and selectors (`boundary`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `boundary.between_overlap` | error | A between selector whose two domains share a region, where the direction of its normal is undefined. |
| `boundary.cycle` | error | Boundaries that name one another in a cycle (in a name, a union, a difference or an except). |
| `boundary.empty_selection` | error, deferred | A named boundary that selects nothing: an error of the check on the resolved boundaries, which `axmp boundaries` and `axmp mesh` run; `axmp validate` does not resolve the boundaries (that needs the mesher, or the info file of an imported mesh) and reports it as deferred. |
| `boundary.imported_mesh_selector` | deferred | A geometric boundary selector on an imported mesh, whose boundaries are the groups of its info file; resolved when the file is read. |
| `boundary.name_collision` | error | One name used by two of the regions, curves, domains and boundaries, which share a namespace. |
| `boundary.partial_match` | warning | A where filter leaves out an edge that satisfies it in part, in a boundary that selects other edges: the filter keeps an edge only when the whole edge satisfies it. |
| `boundary.reserved_name` | error | One of the reserved names axis, exterior and remaining used where it has no meaning. |
| `boundary.selector_grammar` | error | A boundary selector that is not one of the selector forms, or a filter on a form that takes none. |
| `boundary.unknown_name` | error | A boundary or a curve that the document does not define. |

## build (`build`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `build.requires_fluids` | unavailable | An instance mesh handed to the fluids engines (im.fluids_mesh()) in a build without the fluids module: a wheel from PyPI or the sequential source build; the MPI source build has it. |
| `build.requires_mesher` | unavailable | A model document with a geometry in an installation whose mesher does not run: a wheel installed without the mesh extra, or a mesher whose libraries are missing; the validation reports it, and the commands that mesh refuse the document. `Design.export_gdml` refuses with it a mesher that cannot be run or loaded. |

## Couplings (`coupling`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `coupling.empty_overlap` | error | A domain term whose producer and consumer share no region. |
| `coupling.restriction_not_offered` | error | A term restricted to part of the shared domain on a route that cannot restrict it. |
| `coupling.selection_outside_support` | error | The key in of a domain term names a region outside the shared domain of its two physics. |
| `coupling.type_mismatch` | error | A coupling term between physics types that it does not connect. |
| `coupling.uncoupled_pair` | warning | Two physics act on a common region with no coupling term between them. |
| `coupling.unknown_physics` | error | A coupling whose from or to is not a physics of the document. |
| `coupling.unknown_term` | error | A coupling term that is not in the catalogue. |
| `coupling.wrong_selection_key` | error | The key in on a boundary term, or on on a domain term. |

## Domains (`domain`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `domain.unknown_name` | error | A region or a domain that the document does not define. |

## Electrochemistry (`electrochem`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `electrochem.potential_level_free` | error | Every electrode is galvanostatic, so the potential level is free. |

## Expressions (`expr`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `expr.parameter_shadows_variable` | error | A parameter that has the name of a variable of a field expression. |
| `expr.unknown_variable` | error | An expression that names something that is not a variable of its context, a parameter or a constant; also the time t in a datum of an instance that a stationary step solves. |
| `expr.vector_length` | error | A vector datum or a point with the wrong number of components for the symmetry. |

## Flow (`fluid`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `fluid.buoyancy_needs_beta` | error | A region of a flow with the buoyancy term whose material has no fluid.beta_1_K. |
| `fluid.condition_not_offered` | error | A flow condition kind that the route does not offer: the engine refuses it there, or the document path does not expose it yet. |
| `fluid.gravity_direction` | error | A buoyancy term whose gravity is not along the vertical axis, on the Boussinesq route. |
| `fluid.option_not_offered` | error | A flow option value that the engine of the route refuses (the skew convective form in a transient step). |
| `fluid.outlet_stress_form` | warning | An outlet or open boundary with the stress viscous form: zero total traction, which a developed profile does not satisfy. |
| `fluid.pseudo_traction_on_curved_boundary` | warning | An outlet, traction or slip condition on a curved boundary with the Laplacian viscous form imposes a pseudo-traction. |

## Geometry (`geometry`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `geometry.arc_degenerate` | error | An arc path with a radius that is not positive, or an arc shorter than 1e-7 m (radius times angle span), which the CAD kernel cannot build. |
| `geometry.arc_negative_r` | error | An arc path that reaches r < 0, in any electromagnetic design but a cross-section (xsec) one (a planar design on an imported mesh included) and in an axisymmetric model document: it crosses the symmetry axis or lies beyond it. |
| `geometry.arc_span` | error | An arc path whose angles span more than one turn (2 pi radians), or are not finite; the angles of an arc are in radians. |

## Heat transfer (`heat`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `heat.condition_not_offered` | error | A heat condition kind that the route's engine refuses, or that the advective form excludes. |
| `heat.data_not_regionwise` | error | A conductivity or a heat source that differs from region to region on a route that takes one expression over the instance. |
| `heat.option_not_offered` | error | A heat option value that the route's engine refuses or cannot express (a P1 temperature or a conservative form on the Boussinesq route). |
| `heat.prescribed_advection_partial` | error | A prescribed velocity that covers part of the heat instance, or a second one. |
| `heat.supg_needs_advection` | error | SUPG stabilization on a heat instance that nothing advects. |
| `heat.two_advections` | error | A heat instance with both a prescribed velocity and an advection term. |

## Internal (`internal`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `internal.mesh_export` | error | The meshed model or an exporter of an instance mesh met what a valid document never produces (a boundary face of an instance without an atom, mesher files that disagree with the library's resolution of the boundaries, a curved mesh for a P1 chemistry field or for a route that needs straight elements): a defect of the program, not of the document. |

## Materials (`material`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `material.block_incomplete` | error | A material block without the key it needs (a thermal block without k_W_mK, a fluid block without mu_Pa_s). |
| `material.conductivity_ambiguous` | error | A material with sigma_S_m at the material level and in its electric block, with different values. |
| `material.expansion_ambiguous` | error | A material with both mechanical.alpha (the total contraction strain) and mechanical.alpha_1_K (the coefficient per kelvin). |

## Mesh (`mesh`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `mesh.generation_failed` | error | The mesher ran and failed on the geometry of a model document: the message carries the mesher's error and the hint the path of its log. |
| `mesh.geometry_order_lowered` | warning | The default geometry order is lowered to 1 by a P1 instance, or by an option that needs straight elements, in a model with curved boundaries. |
| `mesh.tangled` | error | A 2D mesh with curved (order-2) elements of which one is tangled (its Jacobian determinant changes sign, vanishes or is inverted against the other elements of its region), refused where the mesh file is read, before anything is solved; electromagnetic designs and imported mesh files raise it too. |

## Outputs (`output`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `output.boundary_not_in_domain` | error | An output of a physics on a boundary that lies outside the domain of that physics. |
| `output.cycle` | error | Expression outputs that read one another in a cycle. |
| `output.force_needs_stress_form` | error, deferred | A force or torque with the Laplacian viscous form on a Navier-Stokes route, on a boundary that is not a wall at rest; deferred to the resolution of the boundaries when the boundary is not a key of the instance's conditions. |
| `output.force_not_offered` | error | A force or torque of a flow on a route whose engine exposes no reaction (the one-way flow-then-heat and the Boussinesq routes); also a force or torque that belongs to no flow (it names a physics that is not a flow, or the document has none). |
| `output.force_on_interior` | error | A force or torque on a boundary interior to the domain of its flow, where the engine has no reaction. |
| `output.grammar` | error | An output whose name is not an identifier, or that lacks a key its kind needs. |
| `output.unknown_boundary` | error | An output on a boundary that the document does not define. |
| `output.unknown_kind` | error | An output kind that does not exist. |
| `output.unknown_physics` | error | An output that names a physics the document does not have. |
| `output.unknown_quantity` | error | A quantity that no physics of the document publishes in this geometry. |

## Patch (`patch`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `patch.operation_failed` | error | An operation of a patch (RFC 6902) that cannot be applied: a path that does not exist, a test that does not hold, an unknown operation or a malformed one; the document is unchanged. |

## Physics instances (`physics`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `physics.boundary_double` | error | Two conditions of a physics cover the same part of the boundary of its domain (the partition rule). |
| `physics.boundary_interior` | error | A condition of a physics on a boundary that is interior to its domain, also when only part of it is (the partition rule). |
| `physics.boundary_outside_domain` | error | A condition of a physics on a boundary that has nothing on the boundary of its domain and nothing inside it (the partition rule). |
| `physics.boundary_uncovered` | error, deferred | Part of the boundary of the domain of a physics has no condition: an error of the check on the resolved boundaries, which `axmp boundaries` and `axmp mesh` run (the partition rule: every part of that boundary carries exactly one condition); `axmp validate` reports it as deferred. |
| `physics.domains_overlap` | error | Two instances of one family on a shared region. |
| `physics.invalid_id` | error | A physics id that is not a lowercase identifier. |
| `physics.material_block_missing` | error | A region in a physics whose material lacks the data the route needs; also an instance that no region can take part in. |
| `physics.property_not_uniform_over_domain` | error | A property that the route takes as one number differs between the regions of the instance. |
| `physics.reserved_id` | error | A physics id that is kept for an electromagnetic section or a later physics type. |
| `physics.source_outside_domain` | error | The key in of a source names a region outside the domain of its physics. |
| `physics.unknown_condition_kind` | error | A condition kind that the physics type does not have. |
| `physics.unknown_option` | error | An option, or a value of an option, that the physics type does not have. |
| `physics.unknown_source_kind` | error | A source kind that the physics type does not have. |
| `physics.unknown_type` | error | A physics type that is not in the catalogue; the hint gives the name to use for another code's name, or the near matches. |

## Property laws (`law`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `law.field_not_provided` | error | A property law reads a field that no physics of the step provides on the region and that the step does not give. |
| `law.range_missing` | error | A property law without the validity range of a field it reads. |
| `law.table_invalid` | error | A table law with too few points, lists of different length, abscissae that do not increase, more than one field, or a tabulated value outside the range its property allows. |
| `law.unknown_field` | error | A property law of a field that no physics publishes. |
| `law.unknown_kind` | error | A property law that is neither an expression nor a table. |
| `law.unknown_option` | error | An interpolation or out_of_range value that a property law does not have. |

## Reactions (`reaction`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `reaction.unknown_kind` | error | An electrode reaction kind that does not exist. |

## Routes (`route`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `route.domains_must_coincide` | error | Two instances of a route that solves them on one mesh have different domains. |
| `route.law_not_offered` | error | A property law of a field in a property that a route of this version takes as a constant. |
| `route.not_implemented` | unavailable | The document is valid and this version cannot solve it: its route is not implemented yet, or no route exists for its combination of physics, coupling terms, geometry and study type; also the refusal of solving a model document, and of meshing a 3D model document, one on an imported mesh, or (in Python) one with no geometry, which this version does not do. |

## Study (`study`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `study.field_not_rampable` | error | A ramp of a field that no engine can warm-start, or of a physics that the step does not solve. |
| `study.initial_from_unknown_step` | error | An initial_from that does not name an earlier step. |
| `study.ramp_end_mismatch` | error | A ramp whose last value is not the value the document gives the field. |
| `study.scale_not_applicable` | error | A continuation scale with nothing to scale in its step: viscosity without a steady Navier-Stokes flow (no flow, a Stokes or Boussinesq flow, or a transient step), or buoyancy without a buoyancy term. |
| `study.solver_value` | error | A solver setting of a study step whose value has the wrong type: not true or false, not a whole number, or not a number. |
| `study.strategy_not_offered` | error | A coupling strategy that the route does not offer; also one_way written for a two-way group. |
| `study.two_way_needs_strategy` | error | A two-way group of physics in a step without a coupling strategy, on no route that has a default. |
| `study.type_not_offered` | error | A step of a study type for which the physics has no route (a stationary step over a reactor). |
| `study.type_reserved` | error | The study types eigen and frequency, which are kept for the electromagnetic analyses. |
| `study.unknown_physics` | error | A study step that names a physics the document does not have. |

## The document (`model`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `model.beta_feature` | warning | A physics type, a coupling term or a route of the document is beta. |
| `model.element_type_not_offered` | deferred | An imported mesh on a route whose engine takes triangles only; checked when the file is read. |
| `model.em_only_operation` | error | A model document given to an operation that works on electromagnetic designs only (sensitivities, optimization, the electromagnetic models, the 3D conversion). |
| `model.em_sections_not_combinable` | error | An electromagnetic analysis section in a document that has a physics section. |
| `model.exterior_not_offered` | error | The value "open" of mesh.exterior in a model document. |
| `model.geometry_order_exceeds_field_order` | error, deferred | A geometry order above the field order of an instance; deferred to the reading of the file for an imported mesh. |
| `model.geometry_order_from_file` | error | The key mesh.geometry_order beside mesh.file: the geometry order of an imported mesh is the file's. |
| `model.geometry_order_not_offered` | error, deferred | Geometry order 2 with an option value that needs straight elements (SUPG of a heat instance); deferred to the reading of the file for an imported mesh. |
| `model.mesh_key_not_offered` | error | A mesh key of an electromagnetic design that a model document does not offer (adapt). |
| `model.mesh_order` | error | The key mesh.order in a model document, where the field order is an option of each physics and the geometry order is mesh.geometry_order. |
| `model.per_depth_key` | error | An absolute input in the spelling of the other geometry: a total in a planar model, or a quantity per metre of depth in an axisymmetric or 3D one. |
| `model.section_needs_physics` | error | A section of a model document (domains, boundaries, reactions, couplings, study or outputs) in a document without a physics section. |
| `model.shape_not_offered` | error | A contour with an elliptical segment in an enabled region of a model document: the bounded meshes take lines and circular arcs. |
| `model.symmetry_not_offered` | error | The symmetry "xsec" in a model document. |

## The file (`json`)

| code | kind | raised for |
|---|---|---|
| `json.duplicate_key` | error | A key repeated in one object of a model document's file, whose value JSON would silently replace. |

## Reserved

Codes that this version names, in the route table, in the details of a deferred finding or in the check on the resolved boundaries that a later version runs, and that no path of this version raises.

| code | kind | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `internal.route_table_out_of_date` | error | An engine refused what validation accepted: a defect of the route table, not of the document. |
| `physics.option_not_offered` | error | An option value that a route refuses, for a physics that is neither a flow nor a heat instance; no route of this version refuses one. |
| `route.single_rank` | unavailable | A route that runs on one MPI rank, asked to run on several. |
